target: SolvBTC.BNB and other Solv Strategies BSC tokens as instant redemption arbitrage analogues of xSolvBTC
reason: Failed farm-scale atomic-exit check. SolvBTC.BNB is an open-fund strategy share on the shared OpenFundMarket, not an XSolvBTCPool instant-redeem share. Solv's September 2026 wind-down notice says BSC SolvBTC.BNB redemption requests are processed in monthly batches. A fresh caller cannot close the redeem slot (OFM: only pool manager), so the xSolvBTC executor cannot buy and redeem it in one transaction. The official BSC Solv Strategies registry lists four strategy shares on this architecture; no separate instant pool was identified for them. Prior protocols:549 and 268 already established the shared market's role-gated settlement. No bot or fork proof because the atomic exit prerequisite fails.
